name: How long does a tankless water heater installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a tankless water heater installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard tankless water heater installation usually takes between 4 to 8 hours, though this can vary depending on whether new gas lines, venting, or electrical circuits need to be installed or upgraded. If you're switching from a traditional tank unit, additional time might be required for removal and disposal. During your initial assessment with CG Plumbing Solutions, we'll provide a clearer timeline based on your specific setup.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 4-8 hours, but can be longer if new lines or electrical upgrades are needed.
